values.note: From the 2027 season reservations move from Yellowstone National Park Lodges to Recreation.gov (opening December 8, 2026); the campground stays Lodges-run. Park-wide limit: 14 nights July 1 - Labor Day, 30 nights otherwise, 44 a summer across all Yellowstone campgrounds. The combined length of RV and towed vehicle must be given when booking.

note: Concession-run (Yellowstone National Park Lodges) campground in partly wooded loops on a bench above the meadows where the Gibbon and Firehole rivers join to form the Madison, 14 mi from West Yellowstone and 16 mi from Old Faithful. Generators 8 am - 8 pm at RV sites only. No cell service. --Claude
summary: NPS + Yellowstone NP Lodges: 278 sites, no hookups, RVs to 40 ft (pull-through/back-in, may not be level); 2027 $38 + taxes; 2027 season 05-07..10-16 (Lodges: to 10-17); booking moves to Recreation.gov for 2027 (opens Dec 8, 2026; facility not yet listed); Senior/Access 50% honoured here. Not waterfront kept. Pin at the entrance road -> move ~370 m to the loops. Website -> madisoncg.htm; phone -> 307-344-7311.
